source: Intern session(s), validated with parseProposals; not edited by hand

proposals.title: Endgame: dump the full hopper, then climb level 3
proposals.rationale: In the final 30 seconds both hubs score, so converting a 6+ fuel hopper into hub points and then climbing level 3 for 30 tower points beats one more collection cycle in the same window.
proposals.situation: Match has 30 seconds or fewer remaining (endgame, both hubs active), 6 or more fuel held, robot in the our_alliance zone, not in contact with an opposing robot.

proposals.title: Gather depot fuel during our inactive shift, then wait on trigger
proposals.rationale: Fuel scored in an inactive hub is worth 0 points, so the best use of our inactive shift is refilling the hopper at a depot and holding ready to fire the moment our hub becomes active.
proposals.situation: Our hub is inactive, at least 5 seconds until the hub shift change, 2 or fewer fuel held, robot in the depot zone, not in contact with any robot.

proposals.title: Score on the move through the left trench, then pick up local fuel
proposals.rationale: The protected trench run is a defender-proof lane that shortens cycle times, so shooting on the move through the left trench and immediately refilling from local fuel sustains our scoring rate during the active shift.
proposals.situation: Our hub is active, at least 10 seconds until the hub shift change, 4 or more fuel held, robot in the our_alliance or neutral zone, not in contact with any robot.

proposals.title: Spin out of the pin, then shadow-defend the opposing scorer
proposals.rationale: A pin past 3 seconds is a foul, so breaking contact with an escape spin and immediately defending the opposing scorer protects our hub without ever holding the pin.
proposals.situation: Robot is in contact with the opposing robot R1 for 2 or more seconds, our hub is active, at least 15 seconds until the hub shift change, 3 or more fuel held.

proposals.title: In the final 30 seconds, climb level 2 instead of another cycle
proposals.rationale: Tower points usually beat one more collect-and-score cycle in the same window, and stopping at level 2 avoids the risk of climbing higher than the ranking point requires.
proposals.situation: Match has 30 seconds or fewer remaining, 2 or fewer fuel held, robot in the our_alliance zone, not in contact with any robot, at least 10 seconds from the match end to complete the climb.
